scenes.text: You probably think sharks have the ultimate sense of smell, easily detecting a tiny drop of blood in a massive swimming pool, but you possess a hidden olfactory superpower that completely crushes them.
When rain hits dry soil, it releases a microbial compound called geosmin, and humans are so incredibly sensitive to this scent that we can detect it at just five parts per trillion.
This makes you literally two hundred thousand times more sensitive to the smell of wet earth than a shark is to blood, an evolutionary gift our ancestors used to track precious water.
The next time you step outside after a storm and enjoy that fresh scent, remember your ancient superpower, and let me know in the comments if you love it, then follow for more!

meta.title: You smell this better than a shark smells blood... #shorts
